title: More Sulfur Cubes
description: Add new sulfur cube types and improve some sulfur cubes with specific blocks like sponge or redstone lamp !
body:
Do you wish to have more uses for the new sulfur cube ?

You can now power your redstone contraptions with the redstone sulfur cube, drain water with the sponge sulfur cube or even emit light with the redstone lamp sulfur cube !

![redstone sulfur cube](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9688efcf1f210fe70b5b499aa2f3352fbe7f440e.png)
